push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 9.2 (best match performance)
push.body:
buddskees, a 9.2 against JamRock  United. The other team's gonna be talking about you on the drive home.

DID WELL
+ A brace against JamRock  United, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's a striker's instinct, and you can't teach that at a clinic.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. You were the best player on the pitch, and you know it. Now stay humble.
+ That 9.2 is your ceiling now. Let's raise it again.
+ 2.0 better than usual. Proud doesn't cover it.
+ A 9.2 ranks as your best match performance. That's who you are on a good day.

WORK ON
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Fundamentals: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes. Mind over matter.
- You and BellyTb1, same defensive work rate homework. Partners: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 4 misplaced passes cost you 0.1. Tidy those and the number climbs.
- Pass accuracy: 83%. That's a B. The A-students among midfielders are at 87%+.
- Passes attempted: 23. Climb to 25+ and you're top quarter.

Back-garden drill: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

buddskees, write this on your hand if you have to: The comeback is always more fun than the setback.

Keep doing you. You're doing great at it. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
An 8.8, BellyTb1. You were the steady hand on the wheel tonight.

DID WELL
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ A goal against JamRock  United. Ball in the net, smile on my face. That's the deal.
+ You & buddskees clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ 1.0 better than usual. The arrow is pointing straight up.
+ Your 5th best match performance (8.8). Keep stacking those.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Try this: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. Brick by brick.
- 71% passing (17 of 24, down from your usual 79%). Here's the trick: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. Little by little.
- You and buddskees, same lesson: defensive work rate. Same answer: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 3 shots off target: -0.1. Little leaks sink big ships.
- Passes attempted: 24. Decent, but top-quarter midfielders get to 25+. That's the next rung.

Practice this: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

Listen here, BellyTb1: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

Take a bow. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.0 against JamRock  United. You were close to a good one. Let's find the missing piece.

DID WELL
+ 1 key pass. You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ You and buddskees had more chemistry than a high school lab.
+ Three points off JamRock  United, 3-2. Put 'em in the bank and let 'em earn interest.

WORK ON
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Bread and butter: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. Small fix, big smile.
- 0.8 down on your average. Even the best hitters have 0-for-4 nights.
- A 7.0 ranks as your 6th worst match performance. Not who you are, just where you were tonight.
- Pass accuracy: 74%. 88%+ is where the magic lives.
- Shots: 2. Average-plus; top forwards are at 3+.

Drill of the day: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: The best ability is availability, and the second best is kindness.

Keep showing up; the results will too. - Coach Lasso
